title: ResourceReference
description: A reusable reference to an SBOM, raw scanner report, provenance document, or evidence blob. URLs are mutable; digests carry content integrity.

uri.description: Location or opaque content URI (e.g. urn:scintx:blob:...).

media_type.description: MIME type of the referenced resource.

digests.description: Map of digest algorithm name to hex-encoded digest (e.g. {"sha256": "..."}). Strongly recommended.

format.description: Well-known format identifier, e.g. cyclonedx, spdx, sarif, in-toto.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp after which an ephemeral URI may be invalid.
